mentions.name: Beacon
mentions.description: A mobile app for instantly finding which friend is free to talk right now and summoning them in a single tap. Users send a beacon to a group, everyone gets a gentle ping, and the first person to answer gets connected for a 1-1 call while everyone else's signal drops silently. It does not log missed calls, so there is no pressure to answer or return calls. Available on the App Store and Android.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on Beacon, which just got approved on the App Store! It’s a mobile app to instantly answer “which friend is free to talk right now?” and summon them in a single tap.
mentions.author: cjflog
